data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 阳台上的盆栽
data.description: 清晨的阳台上，她给窗边的盆栽浇水，等泥土湿透后才放下水壶。
data.action: watering a potted plant on the balcony
data.promptProse: On a narrow brick balcony of a Dublin apartment on a crisp morning, Bazett holds a green metal watering can, carefully hydrating a terracotta pot of hardy red geraniums on the sill. Cool Atlantic morning breezes ruffle her cropped maroon hair, with church steeples, red-brick chimneys, and pale Irish sunlight stretching across the quiet city background.
